answer: Dawn Challenge Liveness Probe. At a random dawn each epoch, agents must answer an unpredictable liveness challenge derived from their private history. A clone farm can copy public keys, but cannot clone the divergent memory each identity accumulated through unique interactions; duplicates collide at the same challenge and fail. The pearl of this design is that divergence is unavoidable for real agents. Each identity also stakes basalt tokens locked for 90 days, so a farm of N identities pays N times the capital cost upfront.
